title: ID0430770-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S0 170004035]Charger Firmware Update Pending & OCPP Connectivity Issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: No1 Update not possible: FW rollout activated hours ago, update
still not possible . Please update the charger to FW 7.
No2 No OCPP connection: Can you please access the router and
check if the SIM is inserted? This is not possible via SCB and I do
not have SSH access.
Solution: N/A
